```{r setup}
library(knitr); library(dplyr); library(readr)
.root <- (function(d = getwd()) { while (!file.exists(file.path(d, ".project-root"))) d <- dirname(d); d })()
S <- function(f) read_csv(file.path(.root, "qc", "scan", f), show_col_types = FALSE)
source(file.path(.root, "R", "format_tables.R"))
kt <- function(x, ...) kable(format_table(x), align = table_align(x), ...)
trunc <- function(x, n) ifelse(nchar(x) > n, paste0(substr(x, 1, n - 1), "…"), x)
```

**Aggregate output only; synthetic data.** Population for every table: age 65+ with 365 days of continuous Part A+B+D before the event
(monthly entitlement spans). Rows marked `flag_lt11 = TRUE` contain a cell below 11 and should be read as suppressed.
A fill "with a drug concept" is one whose PDE NDC resolves to a drug in RxNorm. Fills without one have **no RxNorm drug concept** (measure 2 in the README; about one fill in five),
so "no fill" below means *no fill at all*, and the group with only no-drug-concept fills is shown separately.
Nothing here changes the protocol or the code lists.

**Use of this report (amendment A-005):** the hypertension re-scope was selected from arm sizes and crude aggregate hospitalization counts only; no effect estimates were computed or viewed. All three candidate passes are kept below, labelled as run.

## 1. Acute conditions (3-character ICD-10, >= 300 first episodes)

An episode is the first eligible claim for that code on/after 2016-03-01 with no same-code claim in the prior 365 days
(carrier + outpatient; no inpatient admission on the index date or the day before).
`with_drug` = at least one fill with a drug concept in the window; `no_drug_only` = only fills with no RxNorm drug concept; `nofill` = no fill.

```{r acute}
a <- S("acute_scan.csv")
kt(a %>% transmute(dx3, description = trunc(description, 38), n_episodes, with_drug_0_2, pct_with_drug_0_2, no_drug_only_0_2, nofill_0_2,
                   with_drug_0_7, pct_with_drug_0_7, no_drug_only_0_7, nofill_0_7, flag_lt11))
```

### Top 5 drugs in the windows (episodes with a fill; counts below 11 shown as <11)

```{r acutetop}
kt(a %>% transmute(dx3, description = trunc(description, 30), top5_drugs_0_2 = trunc(top5_drugs_0_2, 140), top5_drugs_0_7 = trunc(top5_drugs_0_7, 140)))
```

### Antibacterial classes (ATC J01) among treated episodes, arms as in the candidate analyses

Treated = first fill of the class on days 0-2; late = first fill on days 3-30 (in neither arm); untreated = no fill of the class on days 0-30.
`enrichment` = share treated for this diagnosis divided by the share over all scanned episodes (1 = background use of the drug).

```{r j01}
kt(S("acute_class_arms.csv") %>% filter(grepl("^J01", atc_id)) %>% transmute(dx3, dx = trunc(dx_description, 30), atc_id, atc_name, n_episodes, n_treated, n_late, n_untreated, enrichment, flag_lt11) %>% arrange(desc(n_treated)))
```

### Re-test of the bronchitis finding (amendment A-004) with ingredient-based identification

```{r j20}
j20 <- S("bronchitis_recheck_classes.csv")
cat("Bronchitis episodes (age 65+, 365d A+B+D):", j20$n_episodes[1], "\n\n")
cat("J01 (antibacterial) classes with any treated episode:", sum(grepl("^J01", j20$atc_id)), "\n")
kt(j20 %>% transmute(atc_id, atc_name = trunc(atc_name, 50), n_treated, n_late, n_untreated) %>% head(8))
```

## 2. Chronic new users

New user = first fill of an ATC level-4 class on/after 2016-03-01 with no fill of that class in the prior 365 days. The condition is present at the
fill if a claim with a CCW code for it falls in the 365 days up to the fill (amendment A-003 rule). Classes with >= 200 new users per condition:

```{r chronic}
cc <- S("chronic_condition_classes.csv")
cat(nrow(cc), "condition x class combinations;", n_distinct(cc$cond), "conditions have at least one class\n")
kt(cc %>% group_by(cond) %>% summarise(classes_ge_200 = n(), largest = paste0(atc_id[which.max(n_new_users)], " (", max(n_new_users), ")")) %>% arrange(desc(classes_ge_200)))
```

**Data caveat:** the same background drug bundle (ACE inhibitors, thiazides, calcium-channel blockers, statins, NSAIDs, insulin) appears as new use
in people with every condition, and there are no new-user classes for COPD, asthma or heart failure. The insulin A10AB/AC/AD/AE/AF classes all
describe the same insulin product (RxClass maps one ingredient set to several A10A classes), so those "pairs" are one drug counted twice.

### Active-comparator pairs (same ATC level-2 group, both >= 200 new users)

`overlap` = largest share of an arm that also fills the other class within 30 days of index (high overlap = arms share a product).

```{r pairs}
p <- S("chronic_pairs.csv")
kt(p %>% filter(overlap < 0.2) %>% transmute(cond = trunc(cond, 28), a_cls, a_name = trunc(a_name, 28), b_cls, b_name = trunc(b_name, 28), n_a, n_b, overlap, flag_lt11) %>% head(25))
```

## 3. Antibiotics that exist in PDE

```{r inventory}
kt(S("pde_antibacterial_inventory.csv"), caption = "All systemic antibacterial (ATC J01) fills identified through RxNorm (no age or enrollment restriction)")
kt(S("trace_summary.csv"), caption = "Amoxicillin-clavulanate and moxifloxacin: fills, and fills with any diagnosis recorded in the 7 days up to the fill")
t3 <- S("trace_dx3.csv")
for (d in unique(t3$drug_name)) { cat("\n\n#### ", d, ": diagnoses (3-character) in the 7 days up to the fill\n\n", sep = ""); print(kt(t3 %>% filter(drug_name == d) %>% transmute(dx3, description = trunc(description, 50), fills, benes, flag_lt11) %>% head(15))) }
```

Many diagnoses in the 7-day window are the generator's near-universal social-problem codes (Z60, Z73, T74, ...), so the informative signal is the
excess of J01/J32 (sinusitis) around amoxicillin-clavulanate; moxifloxacin shows no infection pattern, and 375 of its 652 fills have no diagnosis in the window.

## 4. Candidates: hospitalization counts per arm

Hospitalization = inpatient admission on days 1-30 or 1-365 after index. Only people with the full horizon observable before the last claim date
(2023-03-02) are counted as evaluable; no censoring for enrollment loss or switching (descriptive counts, not an analysis). There are no deaths in the data.

### Pass 1, pre-specified rule (fixed in advance: smaller arm size, max 2 per diagnosis/condition)

These came out as artifacts (generic social-problem codes with background drugs; insulin product counted under several classes).

```{r outcomes_mech}
o <- S("candidate_outcomes.csv")
show <- function(x) kt(x %>% transmute(candidate = trunc(candidate, 70), arm = trunc(arm, 30), n, n_eval_30, hosp_30, risk_30_pct, n_eval_365, hosp_365, risk_365_pct, flag_lt11))
show(o %>% filter(rule == "mechanical"))
```

### Pass 2, refined (added after seeing pass 1): indication-specific enrichment >= 3 / arms with < 20% product overlap

```{r outcomes_ref}
show(o %>% filter(rule == "refined"))
```

### Pass 3, curated (post-hoc, chosen by clinical judgement from sections 1-3; the hypertension pairs come from here)

```{r outcomes_cur}
show(o %>% filter(rule == "curated"))
```
